function.description: WIRELESS / FLEXCONNECT ONLY. Retrieve the FlexConnect AP native VLAN ID configured for a wireless site. This is a wireless-only setting (URI: /sites/{siteId}/wirelessSettings/flexConnectNativeVlan) and applies to FlexConnect access points. The default value is 1 when nothing is explicitly set. Do NOT use this tool to inspect wired switchport trunk native VLANs configured on switch interfaces via 'switchport trunk native vlan' (CLI) — for wired-trunk native VLANs use get_device_switchport_inventory or cli_command_runner('show interfaces trunk', ...).
function.name: api_getNativeVlanSettingsBySite

inheritedSiteNameHierarchy.description: The Inherited Site Name Hierarchy specifies the name hierarchy of a parent site from which Native Vlan Id is inherited.

inheritedSiteUUID.description: The Inherited Site UUID specifies the unique identifier of a parent site from which Native Vlan Id is inherited.

nativeVlanId.description: Native VLAN ID is used for any untagged frames.
